canSay.title: What we can state
canSay.one: Not worse than the best reference, within 2 %, everywhere at medium demand on the grid, and on travel time in real_district at medium demand.
canSay.two: Better on waiting time at medium demand (+2 to +3 %) and with noisy sensors (travel +6 %, waiting +14 %).
canSay.three: Emergency-vehicle delay more than halved compared with Max-Pressure on the grid.

cannotSay.title: What we cannot state
cannotSay.one: “Never worse anywhere”: 21 comparisons out of 36 do not pass.
cannotSay.two: 5 true losses, small ones: travel time at peak against Max-Pressure (−1.2 to −1.7 %) and grid8x8 (−2.1 % and −1.5 %).
cannotSay.three: 16 intervals too wide to conclude, mostly in real_district at peak.

figures.compromise: No controller is the best everywhere
figures.compromiseText: Mean gap to the best of the five controllers, per criterion (smaller is better); last column: the worst gap.
figures.compromiseAlt: Matrix: the candidate has a worst gap of 12 %, against 35 to 99 % for MP, EV-RULE-MP, COOP-FULL and TEAM-RULES.
figures.forestText: Gain over the best reference of each situation, with its 95 % interval; red line: the −2 % margin.
figures.forestAlt: Forest plot: 6 comparisons shown better, 9 shown non-inferior, 5 true losses, 16 too wide to conclude.
figures.ambulancesText: Mean over episodes and 95 % interval, at medium demand and at peak.
figures.ambulancesAlt: Bars: the candidate has a delay of 23 s at medium demand and 44 s at peak, against 52 s and 106 s for Max-Pressure.

honest.title: To say before being asked
honest.text: In real_district at peak and on the grid with pedestrians at peak, the estimate is clearly unfavourable (−0.4 to −11 %, and −6.6 % / −12.9 %): the candidate is probably worse than Max-Pressure there, though 5 seeds are not enough to show it.

finalController.llm: The LLM: a measured negative result. Even a perfect choice of strategy brings at most 2.2 % of travel time, and the LLM advisor added to the candidate does slightly worse than the candidate alone on its test situation.
finalController.credit: TEAM-RULES is our teammate's controller (his LLM team with its rules, without calling the model); the other controllers and the whole combined study are our work.
